proposals.observation: The 'Daily Blog Post' GitHub Actions workflow failed at 06:06 on 2026-05-16, meaning no new blog post was published today. The content queue shows only 1 post queued and 27 published, with the most recent dated 2026-05-10 — a 6-day gap. A broken publishing pipeline directly reduces organic reach and the steady drumbeat of content that warms the ICP before they hit the quiz.
proposals.proposal: Inspect the Daily Blog Post workflow logs for the failure reason. The most likely single-file fix is a malformed or missing front-matter field in the one queued post file that causes the build step to error. Open the queued post's markdown file, confirm all required front-matter fields (title, pubDate, description, tags) are present and correctly typed, then correct whichever field is absent or mis-typed. This is a one-file edit that unblocks the pipeline and ships a new post within minutes of the next scheduled run.

proposals.observation: 3 sessions reached the quiz intro page in the last 48 hours; 0 started, 0 completed. All 3 dropped at 'intro_load' — meaning the page loaded but the first interactive step was never triggered. This is not an audience-quality problem (all traffic is direct, suggesting warm or return visitors). It is a friction or trust problem at the very first moment of commitment. The call-to-action copy or button on the intro screen is failing to move grounded, self-aware earners past the threshold.
proposals.proposal: Edit the quiz intro screen copy to replace a generic or vague CTA with a specific, honest framing that names the actual experience the quiz surfaces — the story beneath the money — rather than a benefit promise. The new text should speak directly to the ICP's quiet awareness that something is off, and make starting feel like a low-stakes honest reckoning rather than a test. Change the primary CTA button label and the single sentence above it to the proposed copy below.

proposals.observation: The 'WoW - Money Vigilance' automation has the highest open rate of the three active sequences at 50%, versus 40% and 37.5% for the others, yet it has the smallest send volume (8 sent vs 15 and 16). This is the sequence most resonant with the ICP — ambitious earners who track carefully but don't act. The sequence is either shorter, entered less often, or triggered by a less prominent quiz result path. Leaning into its framing across other touchpoints is the highest-leverage content move available in the data.
proposals.proposal: Add a short contextual callout to the quiz results page for the Money Vigilance result that reinforces the 'grounded steady observer who won't quite look at the next step' framing, and include a visible prompt to share the result. This increases entry volume into the highest-performing sequence.
